audit.whatIsWrong: Defiant Dance (W) is never mentioned in either layer, in a matchup where it is the reason Teemo's damage still goes through.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' Physical only. Teemo's Toxic Shot poison and Blinding Dart are magic, so the charge blunts the physical portion of his autos and nothing else — an Irelia who W-charges to tank a Teemo trade is eating almost the whole trade anyway. That is a green light a Teemo currently has no way to know about.
audit.corrected: Defiant Dance cuts physical damage only. Your Toxic Shot poison and your Q are magic and pass through it — keep attacking into the charge instead of backing off.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Irelia's R Vanguard's Edge creates a blade ring that stuns on contact' and the full layer's 'Blind + kite it' instruction for Flawless Duet.
audit.why: Riot's text for R: enemies hit are 'damaged and Marked', and the resulting wall 'will damage and slow enemies that walk through it' — the wall slows, it does not stun. The dangerous half is the Mark, because Bladesurge's cooldown 'refreshes' on a Marked target, so one R turns her Q into a repeating dash onto you. Separately, a blind does not stop Flawless Duet at all — Blinding Dart stops basic attacks, and Flawless Duet is an ability. Spacing is the only counter.
audit.corrected: Vanguard's Edge Marks you and the wall slows; the danger is that Marked targets refresh Bladesurge. And Flawless Duet cannot be blinded — only spacing outside the two blades avoids the stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere for the ability the whole matchup is framed around.
audit.why: Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10 and Bladesurge is 10/9/8/7/6 but refunds on a Marked target or a kill, so its printed number is unreliable in a wave. The honest sequencing line is: commit on the E window, not on the Q window.
audit.corrected: Flawless Duet is 16s at rank 1 down to 10s at rank 5 — that is the real trade clock. Bladesurge's 10-to-6s cooldown refreshes on Marked targets and on kills, so never pace a trade off it.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Blind her Q autos so Ionian Fervor stacks collapse and her reset loop goes on cooldown'.
audit.why: Bladesurge is an ability, not a basic attack, so it lands through a blind and still refreshes off Marked minions. The blind stalls Ionian Fervor stacking (which comes from spells hitting) and removes her follow-up autos, but it does not touch the reset loop.
audit.corrected: Blind removes her follow-up autos; it does not stop Bladesurge, which is an ability and lands blinded.

audit.why: Data Dragon: Blinding Dart. Length-neutral swap.

audit.why: Bladesurge heals her on every dash, so she sustains through Toxic Shot chip in exactly the phase the text says you win. The full layer's breakdown.late already carries 'anti-heal stays core', so the gap is only in the lane text — I flagged it rather than forcing a length-matched insert into an already-tight string.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds timing matters here because Bladesurge heals on every reset.

edits.before: Your Liandry's Angueur plus full shroom coverage converts the lane into her nightmare: every Q-dash toward you means landing on a Noxious Trap, which slows, reveals, and burns through her healing. She needs to team-fight to remain relevant at this stage while you freely split-push a shroom-walled lane that she genuinely cannot solo-clear without burning time and HP.
